title: GenerateAllExampleFiles executor
description: Generate every docs example in a single task, fanning out across a worker pool.

parentProject.description: Docs project whose examples are generated, e.g. `ag-grid-docs`.

outputBasePath.description: Base output directory; each example lands under `<outputBasePath>/<parentProject>/...`.

mode.description: Whether to generate development or production example output.

writeFiles.description: Also write each generated file alongside contents.json.
